AUTH-1.plain_broken: lets anyone reach {route} without signing in.
AUTH-1.plain_checked: Every route outside the public list turns away a caller who has not signed in.
AUTH-1.remedy: Add the sign-in guard to the view for {route} (and the admin guard if it is an admin route), as the other protected views have.
AUTH-1.remedy_generic: Add the sign-in guard to every view outside the public list (and the admin guard to each admin view), as the other protected views have.

AUTH-2.plain_broken: lets a user without the role reach {route}.
AUTH-2.plain_checked: Every route with a role guard is reachable only by a user who has that role.
AUTH-2.remedy: Make the role guard on the view for {route} take effect, as it does on the other guarded views, so only that role can reach it.
AUTH-2.remedy_generic: Make every role guard take effect on its view, as on the other guarded views, so only that role can reach it.
AUTH-2.short_name: Role-guarded routes admit only that role

AUTH-3.plain_broken: lets {route} set the signed-in user outside the second-factor step.
AUTH-3.plain_checked: Only one route sets the signed-in user, and only once the second-factor step has begun.
AUTH-3.remedy: Let {route} set the signed-in user only after the second-factor code is checked, or leave that write to the declared second-factor view.
AUTH-3.remedy_generic: Set the signed-in user in one view only, after the second-factor code is checked.

AUTH-4.plain_broken: leaves a signed-in session with no unguarded view that signs it out.
AUTH-4.plain_checked: From every signed-in state an unguarded view signs you out, and the sign-out views clear the session first, on every path.
AUTH-4.remedy: Give every signed-in user an unguarded sign-out view that clears the whole session first, on every path.
AUTH-4.remedy_generic: Give every signed-in user an unguarded sign-out view that clears the whole session first, on every path.
AUTH-4.short_name: Signing out always signs you out

AUTH-5.plain_broken: lets {route} elevate the session without a signed-in admin.
AUTH-5.plain_checked: Every view that elevates the session runs only for a signed-in admin.
AUTH-5.remedy: Give the view for {route} the admin guard, so only a signed-in admin can elevate the session.
AUTH-5.remedy_generic: Elevate the session only in views that carry the admin guard and run for a signed-in user.
AUTH-5.short_name: Step-up sign-in starts only from a signed-in admin

AUTH-6.plain_broken: lets {route} read the Authorization header with no guard.
AUTH-6.plain_checked: No route without a guard reads the Authorization header.
AUTH-6.remedy: Add a guard to the view for {route} that checks the caller before it reads the Authorization header.
AUTH-6.remedy_generic: Guard every view that reads the Authorization header, so it checks the caller first.
